items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for any Woot rights, public-display, alert, affiliate, advertising, or derivative-data decision. Ordinary reversible fleet growth is conditional when it preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution rights; public terms restrict commercial/public data use; four launch-readiness tasks remain open; accuracy, security, measurement, and owner gates are incomplete. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, keep permission outreach unsent, and continue only the existing read-only evidence workstream.

Tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Progress is evidenced by official Woot API, terms, and support records; repository/configuration artifacts; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft terms. No task is closable because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not change launch state, production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, or outreach.

Woot API deal and price-history data: blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident procedures, and request-handling workflow. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log/vendor/incident inventory.

Compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as a blanket growth blocker. Analytics is yellow because source permissions or collector errors remain; revenue is partial aggregate with $4.92 unattributed for 2026-09-21; operations and fleet-doctor sweeps have no results. Recommendation: allow only bounded reversible work preserving existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, provenance, claims, and platform-policy boundaries; keep gated or private launches blocked until site-specific evidence and owner decisions exist.
